human_authorisation.authorisation_note: User explicitly asked to activate threshold_marker_registry next, continuing the chain after S-REG-29 (metric_exercise_link). Research surfaced that all 5 threshold_marker candidate records (ci/registry/s_reg_21_threshold_marker_candidate_records.json) reference sport_metric_ids not present in the live 6-entry sport_metric registry, traced to a second, never-activated sport_metric expansion batch in ci/registry/s_reg_19_sport_metric_candidate_expansion.json (S-REG-27 only ever activated the original S-REG-11 seed batch). Shown this finding, the user chose to extend sport_metric with the 3 needed records (powerlifting__attempt_count, general_strength__set_count, general_strength__duration_seconds) and then activate threshold_marker, rather than hold the domain. The other 3 records in that same S-REG-19 batch are unreferenced by anything and were deliberately left inactive.
